_note: DP-LoRA with the source papers' settings (owner rule 2026-10-26: no baseline tuning; every setting is the authors' value, or one arbitrary documented value where the authors give none). Contract: docs/baselines/DPLORA_DEFAULTS.md (rules R1-R5, per-setting sources). Frozen by frozen/dplora_default_v1.sha256 before any run. Jobs: scripts/queue_dplora_default.py (pipeline_default.py --stage gpu, then queue_baselines.py dplora_cpu; no metric on any evaluation dataset). The Jakarta-tuned frozen_v2.json / frozen.json are not used; their releases stay on disk as 'legacy tuned' reference rows.

sources.kurakin: Kurakin, Ponomareva, Syed, MacDermed, Terzis. Harnessing large-language models to generate private synthetic text. arXiv 2306.01684v2 (11 Jan 2024), the version that adds LoRA. No public code found. Primary author of both parts (rule R1).
sources.yue: Yue, Inan, Li, Kumar, McAnallen, Shajari, Sun, Levitan, Sim. Synthetic Text Generation with Differential Privacy: A Simple and Practical Recipe. ACL 2023 (arXiv 2210.14348v3, 18 Jul 2023). Code: github.com/microsoft/dp-transformers, research/synthetic-text-generation-with-DP (commit 4ec84e92bc4b221233ce2c6778b3e7a81809e85b). Secondary source (rule R2).

0.5b.source: owner rule: the backbone of our method (main grid)

7b.source: owner rule: 7B robustness row; grad_ckpt and the micro-batch token budgets are memory-only (the clipped sum does not depend on the split; test_dp.py (e)) and are the frozen v2 7B values

settings._not_keyed_by_eps: the same values at every eps; only sigma is recalibrated by the accountant for the target eps (EPS28 rule: eps 2 = eps-1 settings, eps 8 = eps-4 settings, identical here)

frozen_code_defaults_kept.optimizer: AdamW(betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0) = Adam without weight decay
frozen_code_defaults_kept.loss: per-example mean token cross-entropy over the response tokens + end token (Prefix-LM loss with per-example normalisation)
frozen_code_defaults_kept.sampling: Poisson, q = batch / N_REF, T = round(epochs / q), N_REF = 74685; noisy sum / B_NOM = batch
frozen_code_defaults_kept.accountant: PRV (Opacus) calibration to (eps, 1e-6), add/remove one trail; vp: PLD composition with the prior at eps - 0.015
frozen_code_defaults_kept.vp_prior: vp.py: 10% of mu^2 to the venue and category Gaussian histograms, alpha_share 0.1, max_popular 2000, threshold_sigmas(n_venues)

expected_accounting._how: computed 2026-10-26 before any run from public inputs only (dplora/accounting.py, vp.py calibrate); the runs recompute them
